title: Invoice status (mirrored from Stripe)
caption: `platform.invoices.status`, copied from Stripe's re-fetched invoice by the handler of `invoice.finalized`, `invoice.paid`, `invoice.payment_failed` and `invoice.voided` (no audit row); listed by listInvoices and adminListInvoices. Draft invoices are never stored.

states.label: open
states.detail: The first stored state: a finalized invoice. `invoice.payment_failed` while still unpaid queues `billing.payment_failed` to every active owner (once per attempt).

states.label: uncollectible
states.detail: Marked in Stripe; the row shows it at the next handled event of the invoice.

states.label: draft (CHECK only)
states.detail: Allowed by the CHECK; a draft invoice ends the event `ignored` with `INVOICE_DRAFT`.
